title: Art Rules
content: Yesterday I listened to a lecture where a professional artist said "You can't paint a landscape without showing the horizon or the sky. Any painting without at least some sky will be oppressive. Stay away from it."That made me want to go outside and try an experiment to see if I could create a feeling of openness and freedom without showing the horizon or the sky.I also thought ofSargent's famous Alps paintings, which often don't have any sky. Have you questioned any art rules that you were taught and found them to be untrue for you.?
